title: test(console): record the ruled reason aspect-ratio stays uncurated (objectui#8628)
body:
Fixes #8628
Clause-②: no

Executes ruling `5634038424` (letter B), ratified `5810240972`: `aspect-ratio` stays out of `PUBLIC_BLOCKS`, and its ledger entry now records the reason instead of "NOT YET RULED, either way". Implemented by the `domain:ui` seat #1, session `https://claude.ai/code/session_01BA3nKVUwKQJf8DBxrSVtNC`.

## What changed

- `apps/console/src/__tests__/public-contract.test.ts`: the `UNCURATED_LAYOUT_CONTAINERS['aspect-ratio']` entry is replaced with the ruled reason. A ratio box is `box` plus an aspect utility, and the curated vocabulary carries one spelling per concept (the `element:image` reasoning). The entry cites the ruling by id (objectui#8628, `5634038424`, ratified `5810240972`). It also says in one sentence why the entry lives in this ledger and not in `DELIBERATELY_UNCURATED`, so the next reader does not move it.
- `.changeset/8628-aspect-ratio-uncurated-reason.md`: empty frontmatter. The changeset-presence gate guards `apps/console/src/**` with test files included, and asked for this before it was added. The empty frontmatter declares that nothing is released.

## Why the entry stays in `UNCURATED_LAYOUT_CONTAINERS` when the ruling names `DELIBERATELY_UNCURATED`

This was measured. Both ledgers are pinned by exact-equality assertions, over disjoint derived populations:

- `DELIBERATELY_UNCURATED` is pinned by "curates every shipped semantic block, or records why not". That test takes the shipped blocks in the `record` / `page` / `element` / `action` namespaces, removes the ones in `PUBLIC_BLOCKS`, and requires the rest to `toEqual` the ledger's keys.
- `UNCURATED_LAYOUT_CONTAINERS` is pinned by "curates every declared layout container, or records why not". That test takes the `LayoutSchema` arm spellings with `isContainer: true`, removes the ones in `PUBLIC_BLOCKS`, and requires the rest to `toEqual` the ledger's keys.

`aspect-ratio` registers with `namespace: 'ui'`, so it belongs to the second population only. I probed this on the base tree (`aa38e195d`) by planting an `aspect-ratio` key in `DELIBERATELY_UNCURATED`. The edit went through `ablation-replace.mjs` (anchor count 1 to 0, blob changed), and the file was restored to the HEAD blob with an empty `git diff HEAD`. The first pin went red:

    AssertionError: expected [ 'action:bar', 'element:image', …(4) ] to deeply equal [ 'action:bar', 'aspect-ratio', …(5) ]
    Tests  1 failed | 18 skipped (19)

Removing the key from `UNCURATED_LAYOUT_CONTAINERS` would turn the second pin red: it checks exact equality over a population that contains `aspect-ratio`, as the green base run shows. Moving the entry would therefore mean loosening one of the pins. So, per the dispatch's first Zone 2 assumption, the text is replaced in place. The ruling's two execution items ("the ledger entry plus the pin's ledger row") land on the same row. No pin, failure message or population derivation changed.

## Left alone on purpose

- `packages/components/src/renderers/layout/aspect-ratio.tsx`: the registration comment ("Not in `PUBLIC_BLOCKS`, so the react-page scope builder never saw this tag and the declaration removes no injected identifier") states a consequence of the containment declaration. It does not suggest the absence is unexplained, and it is still true. Editing it would be a `src/` edit to a released package with no change in meaning.
- The seven sectioning tags' shared `SECTIONING_TAG_UNRULED` text is untouched. objectui#8775 holds that decision.
- `git grep -n 8628` outside `.changeset/`: the replaced entry was the only reference to this card. Every other hit is RFC 8628 or a numeric literal.
- `PUBLIC_BLOCKS`, the manifest, the intrinsics and every roster are unchanged. `git diff --name-only aa38e195d HEAD` lists exactly the two files above. The diff is empty on `packages/core/src/registry/public-blocks.ts`, `packages/components/src/renderers/` and `packages/types/`. `sdui.manifest.json` and `sdui-intrinsics.d.ts` are untracked build outputs of `gen-manifest.ts`, generated from that registry and list, so neither can move.

## Verification (head `d98b2140e`)

- `pnpm exec vitest run apps/console/src/__tests__/public-contract.test.ts packages/components/src/renderers/__tests__/container-declaration-census.test.tsx`, run through `os-verify-lock.sh`: `Test Files 2 passed (2)`, `Tests 49 passed (49)`, the same counts as the base run. The only other file that names either ledger (`packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/previews/block-types.ts`) mentions it in a comment and is not a test.
- Console type-check, **narrowed and declared**. Dependency `dist/` was not built, so `tsc --noEmit -p apps/console` exits 2 on unresolved workspace modules, both before and after this change. I ran it on the base bytes and on the head bytes of the edited file, in the same tree, with the file swapped and then restored by blob hash. Both runs produce 477 diagnostics, and the two sets are identical once the edited file's line numbers are masked. The only difference is a +4 line shift below the edit. `--listFiles` confirms the test file is in the program. The full `Type Check` job is left to CI.
- eslint, **narrowed and declared**. `eslint --no-inline-config --format json` on the test file reports 1 file, 0 errors, 0 warnings. The changeset `.md` is outside eslint's configured population ("File ignored because no matching configuration was supplied"). The test file's resolved config has empty `parserOptions`, so type-aware linting is off and this diff cannot change the result for any file it did not touch.
- `pnpm check:control-bytes` OK · `pnpm check:new-line-citations` `0 new citation(s)` · `node scripts/check-changeset-presence.mjs` passes (1 changeset, empty frontmatter) · `pnpm check:changeset-claims` passes · `check-test-path-roots` and `check-vi-mock-override-shape` OK · `check-governed-queue-guard --test` reports NOT GOVERNED.

## Acceptance notes

- The entry records the ruling's reason as the ruling states it. It does not measure whether every aspect utility an author might write reaches compiled CSS. That question applies to every authored `className`, not only this one, and was not measured here.
- The first attempt at the probe above did not run: its replacement text still contained the anchor, `ablation-replace.mjs` refused it (anchor count 1 to 1) and restored the file. The quoted red comes from the second attempt, with a replacement that does not contain the anchor.
